extracted.name: Air fryer omelette
extracted.description: Use your air fryer to make a simple omelette with your choice of fillings – grated cheese, fried mushrooms, wilted spinach, feta or chopped ham all work well
ingredient_lines: fillings of your choice, such as grated cheese, fried mushrooms, wilted spinach, crumbled feta or chopped ham
instruction_lines: Heat the air fryer to 180C with a heatproof non-stick pan inside (a round pan will create a more traditional omelette shape). Put the butter in the pan and heat for 30 seconds more.
Beat the eggs with a few cracks of black pepper, then mix in your chosen fillings. If using cheese, add a handful to the eggs, leaving the rest to sprinkle on at the end.
Pour the egg mixture into the pan and cook for 8-10 mins until puffed up and golden. If you have reserved cheese, sprinkle it over the omelette. Serve with salad.
